usage.title: Usage Statistics
usage.subtitle: View AI model usage and cost statistics
usage.hitRateHelp: Cache hits ÷ (fresh input + cache writes + cache hits)
usage.speedHelp: Output tokens per second, from the first token to the end. Only requests through the routing service with at least 100 output tokens count; for models that hide their reasoning it's an approximation. A value with ≈ is estimated from session-log timestamps when routing is off: there is no first-token timing, so the wait for the first token is included and the number reads low. Only requests with at least 200 output tokens are estimated.
usage.speedSumHelp: Total output tokens divided by total generation time, not a per-request average. Only routed requests with at least 100 output tokens count. A value marked with ≈ is estimated from session-log timestamps (it includes the first-token wait and only counts requests with at least 200 output tokens), shown only when a row has no routed data.
usage.estimatedTimingTip: About {{duration}}s (estimated from session-log timestamps, including the wait for the first token)
usage.speedTooFew: Fewer than 100 output tokens, speed not counted
usage.speedEstimateTooFew: Fewer than 200 output tokens, speed not estimated
usage.noTimingSession: Session logs have no timing data
usage.noFirstToken: No first-token timing, speed not counted
